name: GAN V100 MagLev Frosted 3x3
description: The GAN V100 MagLev Frosted 3x3 is GAN’s latest innovation for speedcubers and cube enthusiasts seeking peak performance. This premium 3x3 features a modern frosted matte exterior for improved grip and visual appeal. At a compact 55mm, it offers unparalleled control and handling suitable for all solving styles.
features: Advanced MagLev tension system powered by 76 strategically placed magnets, reducing friction and delivering buttery-smooth, consistent turns.
Fine-tune your experience with 72 unique setting combinations using the beloved GAN16 tension adjustment system.
Ultra-lightweight design—just 64 grams—minimizes hand fatigue during long or intense solving sessions.
Distinctive black internal plastic adds an extra layer of visual sophistication.
